a_hypothesis_refuted_before_it_was_publi.verdict: REFUTED. The sample that suggested it also carried a partialtrap component and a direct hit; the suffix was not the whole difference. Measured before claiming rather than after.

the_29_are_the_C55_class_in_a_population: C61 measured render omission on the non-switch, empty-majority-arm population and found ZERO, and I reported that the C55 class does not extend to the residue. That was true of the population I measured and false as a general statement. On switch rows the class is present: the engine's branch reproduces the incoming Pokemon at exactly the right HP -- so the state transition is right -- while emitting no HP events for that slot at all. The outcome is modelled and not described, which is precisely the C55 defect.
why_the_earlier_negative_was_not_wrong_b: C61 restricted to rows whose MAJORITY arm was empty and whose slots did not switch. This population is defined by a switch and judged on any included branch. Two disjoint slices, two different answers, and I generalised from the first.
next: locate where the renderer drops HP events on a switch boundary. C55's fix was in the Sleep Talk block; this is a different site, and the same discipline applies -- find where an outcome is applied without being described, rather than relaxing the comparison.
